message.reasoning:
I am ready to play Monopoly and make a decision.

I have $1,181 and two properties: READING_RAILROAD and MARVIN_GARDENS. Player 1 owns the pink set and several other spaces. Player 3 has only the Electric Company. Player 4 owns the orange set and several others.

Player 4 rejected my $450 offer for Ventnor. They want $500 or more. Paying that would leave me with only $681 and give player 4 enough cash to buy Boardwalk. I will not overpay. The yellow monopoly is not yet locked because Atlantic is still unowned.

Player 1 has no yellows to trade. Player 3 only has the Electric Company and lots of cash. Player 4 owns Pennsylvania Avenue, which is part of a green set. I will try to trade for it.

I will end the turn. I rejected a trade this turn, so I should not haggle further on Ventnor. I have enough cash to stay liquid. I am now checking whether player 1 or player 3 has anything worth trading.

Player 1 owns Vermont, St. Charles, States, St. James, and Water Works. None of these complete a set for me. Player 3 only has the Electric Company. I am now considering whether to trade Reading RR for Player 4's Pennsylvania RR to double my rent income.
